purpose: Check bounded joint replacement of complete old-parent consumer sets. Single virtual insertions may all fail the service gate while a pair removes old captures and passes.
cohort: Exactly the already inspected virtual_parents_r1 cohort; no new blind-test claim.
candidate_pool: Same fixed absent nontrivial pairwise intersections of original rows as virtual_parent_plan.
algorithm: At each iteration evaluate each remaining candidate as one insertion. Keep strict single-insertion arithmetic improvements, rank by total additions, then wide read+write events, then numeric mask. Retain top8. Evaluate all unordered pairs within this shortlist if two insertion credits remain. Among all admissible improving singles and these pairs, choose lowest additions, then lowest wide events, then fewer new nodes, then lexicographic masks. Rebuild original largest-subset graph and prune unused virtual nodes as before. Charge insertion credits even if older virtual nodes become unused. Stop when no admissible trial exists or four credits used.
resource_gate: Strict additions decrease; source coefficient reads, total wide read+write events and popcount-order peaklive do not increase relative to the current accepted graph.
structural_certificate: Relative to original graph count live new nodes V, new-node parents q, old roots acquiring parent r, old original parent captures removed D and newly required original captures U. Verify delta_reads=r+q and delta_writes=V+U-D on every accepted graph. Event gate requires D>=V+U+r+q.
planner_cost: Record single and pair trials and candidate shortlist caps. Exhaustive single scoring is still CPU research work; not claimed as the implementation of the eventual circuit selector.
counterexample: p1={a,x},p2={b,y}; four output rows {a,b,c,d,x}, {a,b,c,d,y}, {a,b,e,f,x}, {a,b,e,f,y}. Both virtual intersections needed together: baseline14adds/6ports/peak2; each alone13adds/7ports; both12adds/6ports/peak2. Reproduce in code and preserve original destinations.
boundary: Inherited intersection algebra and existing full-tile information. No claim of global optimization, RTL speedup, mapped capacity, PPA, AEE or FP32 equivalence.
